Payroll is about much more than salaries. In this role, you will help ensure that colleagues across Denmark are paid accurately and on time, while providing support on topics such as pay, vacation, parental leave and time registration. Whether you already have experience in payroll or are looking to build expertise in a specialist area, this is an opportunity to develop your skills while making a meaningful difference to employees across Novo.

Your new role

Your main responsibilities will be:

·       Support employees across Denmark with questions related to salary, pension, taxation, vacation, parental leave and time registration.

·       Handle employee cases and phone enquiries, providing clear, professional and helpful guidance in every interaction.

·       Learn and develop expertise across payroll processes through structured training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues.

·       Contribute to the accurate and timely delivery of payroll, helping ensure colleagues receive the right pay at the right time.

·       Collaborate with Payroll colleagues and other specialist teams to resolve enquiries and continuously improve employee support.

·       Take part in the optimisation and digitalisation of payroll processes, supporting Novo’s ambition to simplify and improve the employee experience.

Together with your colleagues, you will support a high-volume payroll operation that handles more than 55,000 employee cases and calls annually, making a positive difference through every interaction.

Your new department

You will join the Payroll team within Corporate Accounting, part of Finance Operations at Novo. Together, the team supports approximately 34,000 employees across Novo and affiliated companies, ensuring accurate payroll delivery and providing guidance on payroll-related topics.

The team consists of 18 colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences who work closely together to deliver high-quality service. We continuously explore new technologies, digital solutions and AI tools to improve our processes and create a better experience for employees across the organisation.

Your skills and qualifications

You are motivated by delivering great service and interested in developing expertise within payroll. Whether you bring experience from payroll, HR or another office-based function, you combine a structured approach with curiosity, accountability and a willingness to learn.

To succeed in this role, you have:

·       Relevant experience from an administrative, customer service, HR, finance or other office-based role.

·       Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality, accurate work.

·       The ability to work independently, manage priorities and maintain quality in a fast-paced environment.

·       Confidence using digital tools, with experience in MS Outlook, Excel and Word. Experience with SAP Payroll/HR or ServiceNow is an advantage but not required.

·       An interest in systems, technology and AI-enabled tools to simplify and improve ways of working.

·       Fluency in both Danish and English, written and spoken.

You are a collaborative and service-minded professional who enjoys helping others, sharing knowledge and finding practical solutions. You build trust through clear communication, take ownership of your responsibilities and contribute positively to the team, even during busy periods.

Working at Novo

Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.

What we offer

There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 383,200 to 563,400 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Contact

For further information about the position, please contact Sr Manager Shamila Nielsen on +45 30777770. Please be advised Shamila will not support queries about your recruitment status.

Deadline

October 25th, 2026

Applications will be reviewed, and interviews will take place on an ongoing basis. Therefore, do not hesitate to apply if interested at your earliest convenience.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application, but please include a few sentences about why you are applying in your resume or CV. To ensure an efficient and fair recruitment process, please refrain from adding a photo to your CV.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

At Novo, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

Job Title: Regulatory Content Writer

Department: Content Innovation & Management, Clinical Reporting, Research & Development

Location: Søborg, Denmark

Your impact begins here

As Regulatory Content Writer, you will play a key role in transforming the way regulatory documents are created in the pharmaceutical industry. Working with NovoScribe, Novo’s automated authoring platform, you will drive document processes and deliver high-quality regulatory content through automation and structured authoring. Your work will help accelerate the adoption of content automation, strengthen content quality and shape how complex scientific information is communicated across clinical development.

What you’ll bring

You enjoy combining scientific expertise with innovation, technology and collaboration. You thrive in a dynamic environment, take ownership of your work and are motivated by improving how complex scientific information is communicated. To succeed in this role, you will bring:

• An MSc degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biology, Biochemistry, Medicine or a related scientific discipline.

• Excellent written English, with a demonstrated ability to communicate complex scientific information clearly and accurately.

• The ability to improve processes and promote the sharing of better practices.

• Strong stakeholder management, collaboration and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.

• Strong analytical capabilities, attention to detail, intellectual curiosity and a proactive mindset.

• Enjoyment in challenging established ways of working and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that create meaningful business impact.

What you’ll do

You will be an integral part of a team leading the way in automated document creation. The team works where regulatory content and technology meet, focusing on content, efficient document workflows, consistency, operational implementation and the continuous optimisation of NovoScribe. You will:

• Drive the development of regulatory documents in line with established guidelines and SOPs.

• Plan content creation and set timelines for document production and review.

• Evaluate documents for coherence, precision, scientific rigour, and consistent information and messaging.

• Maintain and expand the text library in the database, and provide input to improve the database.

• Actively improve best practices and innovate the way we work.

• Maintain an updated understanding of essential regulatory, scientific, and medical subjects pertinent to drug development, designated products, and specific disease/therapeutic domains.

Who you’ll work with

You will join Content Innovation & Management within Clinical Reporting, a globally connected organisation that advances how scientific and regulatory content is created, managed, standardised and delivered. The team works across multiple functions and geographies to drive innovation, strengthen content quality and support the clinical development value chain through modern digital tools and ways of working.

In Research & Development, colleagues explore bold scientific ideas and advance them into clinical testing, combining curiosity, AI tools and human data. Through collaboration and operational excellence, we shape and deliver an innovative pipeline to meet future patient needs. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve processes, content libraries and digital tools.

What you can expect here

You will join a global healthcare company where you can contribute your expertise, build new skills and help shape the future approach to documentation across the organisation. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to help shape the future of automated regulatory documentation, apply for the Regulatory Content Writer role by 25 October 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

As Senior Portfolio Manager, you will help ADI make clearer, faster decisions about where its effort goes. You will partner with ADI areas to manage their activity portfolios, turn portfolio data into insight decision makers can act on, and strengthen the concepts and tools behind governance and annual planning. Your work brings transparency to trade-offs across Research & Development, so the right activities move forward with momentum, and resources go where they create the most value.

What you’ll bring

You know how to turn complex portfolio data into clear recommendations, and how to bring people with you when you have no formal authority. You will also bring:

• A master’s degree in business administration, economics, finance, engineering, life sciences or another relevant field.

• 5–8 years of relevant experience in portfolio management, business planning, consulting, project management, change management or a related discipline.

• Experience creating and quality-assuring portfolio, product or financial data, analyses, reporting and decision materials for senior stakeholders.

• A proven ability to solve problems, plan and execute workstreams, manage improvement initiatives and coach stakeholders in a complex matrix organisation.

• A solid understanding of business processes, governance and annual planning cycles.

• Strong analytical, facilitation and communication skills, with sound judgement and the ability to navigate ambiguity and competing priorities.

• Fluent English.

Desirable, but not essential: Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience; experience with portfolio or work-management tools; experience using automation or AI-enabled tools to improve workflows; certifications in Lean Six Sigma, agile project management, change management or product management.

What you’ll do

You will make portfolio management and governance work in practice – simple to use, grounded in data and focused on value.

• Partner with selected ADI areas to manage their activity portfolios, ensuring alignment with business strategy, value-based decisions and effective tracking of performance and outcomes.

• Turn portfolio data into actionable insights, dashboards and presentations, and represent Portfolio Management & Governance in selected ADI and R&D governance forums.

• Own and evolve selected concepts, artefacts and tools, such as the activity-based cost model, value framework, Product Team Playbook and the portfolio management and OKR environment in Azure DevOps, so they stay current and easy to use.

• Lead improvement projects end to end to update, replace or automate portfolio concepts, tools and processes, testing and scaling AI-enabled tools where they improve data quality, efficiency or user experience.

• Drive adoption of new ways of working, with a focus on the annual planning cycle, by coaching stakeholders across the matrix and building alignment without formal authority.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Portfolio Management & Governance team within ADI, part of R&D, and report to the Head of Portfolio Management & Governance. In R&D, colleagues explore scientific ideas and advance them towards clinical testing, bringing together curiosity, data, technology, collaboration and operational excellence.

Your closest partners will be leadership and executing teams in your assigned ADI areas, together with your Portfolio Management & Governance colleagues. You will also work with ADI Finance and support functions such as Product Management Excellence and Tech Delivery Excellence, R&D line-of-business stakeholders who sponsor, enable or adopt ADI projects and products, and the governance bodies that set priorities. Externally, you will work with consultants and partners supporting portfolio concepts, tools and improvement initiatives.

With a global scope, you will bring these perspectives together, create clarity on trade-offs and help decisions move forward at pace.

What you can expect here

You will be trusted to work with a high degree of autonomy, making independent recommendations, leading projects from scope to benefit realisation and guiding colleagues as a subject-matter expert. Your voice will shape how portfolio decisions are prepared and made across ADI.

You will build new skills through hands-on work with data, automation and AI-enabled tools, as Novo upskills its workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation. You will also contribute to team priorities and knowledge sharing in a team that values respect, honest feedback and continuous improvement.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary for employees based in Denmark ranges from 742,600 to 1,091,600 DKK. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Job Title: Cyber Security Awareness Specialist

Department: Digital Resilience, Cyber Risk and Resilience

Location: Ballerup

Your impact begins here

As Cyber Security Specialist, you will lead and develop how Novo builds security awareness, culture and training. You will turn cyber risks, threat intelligence, policies, audit findings and incidents into clear, practical learning that helps colleagues make secure decisions in their everyday work. Working across business areas and geographies, you will strengthen employee resilience and show measurable progress in security behaviour – helping protect the people, data and operations Novo relies on to serve people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you’ll bring

You know how to make cyber security make sense to people – and how to show that behaviour is changing. You will also bring:

• A master’s degree or equivalent in cybersecurity, information security, computer science, risk management, organisational psychology, learning and development, communications, business administration or a related discipline.

• Several years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, security awareness, privacy, compliance or a related discipline.

• Proven experience leading or significantly contributing to enterprise-wide awareness, role-based training, communication campaigns and behaviour-change initiatives for diverse audiences.

• Strong skills in learning design, communication and facilitation, with the ability to simplify complex cyber topics without losing accuracy.

• Experience engaging senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders, and influencing without formal authority.

• Solid programme and project management skills, including managing suppliers, budgets and delivery partners.

• Experience defining programme measures, analysing results and using data to demonstrate effectiveness and guide priorities, including work with learning platforms, awareness tools and digital channels.

• A global mindset and the judgement to adapt your approach across cultures, languages and operational contexts.

Useful, but not essential:

• Experience from a large, complex or international organisation, or from a regulated industry.

• Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, NIS2 or comparable frameworks and requirements.

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Security+, SANS security-awareness certifications or equivalent.

What you’ll do

This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on delivery. Success means secure behaviour becomes part of everyday work: the right audiences receive relevant content, stakeholders understand their role in building resilience, and data shows sustained improvement in awareness, reporting and secure decision-making.

• Develop and deliver a risk-based security awareness, culture and training strategy aligned with cyber risk priorities, the Digital Resilience roadmap and enterprise needs.

• Assess behavioural needs and design role-based learning, onboarding, mandatory training and campaigns for employees, leaders, technical teams, privileged users, contractors and other key audiences.

• Translate policies, threat intelligence, audit findings, incidents and control gaps into practical guidance, simulations and behaviour-change activities.

• Build security champion and awareness networks, and manage platforms, suppliers, budgets and delivery partners so activities stay globally relevant.

• Define meaningful metrics, report progress and risks to stakeholders, and use data, employee feedback, incident trends and emerging threats to keep improving the programme.

Who you’ll work with

You will join the Digital Resilience team within Cyber Risk and Resilience.

Your work will reach across business areas, geographies and professional disciplines. You will partner with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, and with security champions and awareness networks who carry secure habits into their own teams. You will also work closely with suppliers and delivery partners to bring programmes to life at scale.

Your audiences range from employees and leaders to technical teams, privileged users and contractors. Keeping the work clear, focused and grounded in real risk will help these relationships move from awareness to action.

What you can expect here

You will own an agenda that matters to the whole organisation, with the trust to shape strategy and the opportunity to deliver it hands-on. Your expertise will be valued, and you will be encouraged to make your voice heard, challenge convention and turn ideas into initiatives that colleagues use.

You will build new skills by working across functions, cultures and markets, and you will join a company that is upskilling its entire workforce to advance AI as a main driver for innovation. Clear expectations and a culture that recognises results will help you deliver your best work and see your progress.

Salary

For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to make secure behaviour part of everyday work at Novo – and prove it with data – apply for the Cyber Security Specialist role by the 25th of October.

**Join our Chipset team and help bring the next generation of hearing technology to life

**Are you passionate about electronics and practical problem-solving? Do you enjoy working hands-on with hardware, supporting users, and helping turn ideas into working solutions? If so, we encourage you to apply.

At Demant, we develop state-of-the-art chipsets that power our hearing healthcare products used by millions of people worldwide. We are looking for a Junior Chipset Engineer to support our development teams by maintaining and troubleshooting chipset platforms, supporting internal users, and contributing to the development of new chipset test solutions.

**Welcome to Chipset

**Chipset is a key division within our Research & Development organization. We design and develop advanced integrated circuits and chipset platforms that power our world-leading hearing instruments and accessories.

Our commitment to technological excellence drives us to deliver professional-grade solutions in DSP processing, audio quality, connectivity, AI integration, and rechargeability, all in compact form factors with extremely low power consumption.

You will become part of a team of highly skilled engineers working across analog IC design, digital IC design, verification, test development, and system integration. Together, we create the technologies used in products from Oticon, Philips, Bernafon, and other leading hearing healthcare brands.

**The Role

**As a Junior Chipset Engineer, you will play an important role in both supporting our chipset development activities and contributing to the development of the next generation of chipset test platforms.

You will act as a key point of contact for internal users of our chipset development platforms while also participating in hardware development activities under the guidance of experienced engineers.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Provide support for chipset hardware platforms and development boards.

• Prepare, maintain, and improve chipset boards and lab setups.

• Assist with schematic design and PCB layout of test boards.

• Contribute to the development of chipset test systems.

• Bring up, test, debug, new hardware designs.

• Perform soldering and rework of prototype hardware.

• Document solutions, procedures, and designs in compliance with quality requirements.

• Collaborate with verification teams, as well as external suppliers.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to chipset development, from practical laboratory work and user support to hardware design and test system development.

**About You

**You may have a background as an Electronics Technician, Laboratory Technician, Electrical Engineering Technician, or a recently graduated Electronics Engineer.

We imagine that you have:

• a solid understanding of electronics and electronic measurement techniques

• hands-on experience with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and logic analyzers

• an interest in hardware development, troubleshooting, and practical problem solving

• good documentation and communication skills

• a structured and service-minded approach to your work

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

• schematic capture and PCB layout tools such as Cadence or OrCAD

• prototype hardware debugging and bring-up

• soldering and rework of electronic assemblies

• automated test systems

• scripting or automation using Python

• Quality Management Systems (QMS)

**The Ideal Candidate

**We are looking for someone who:

• enjoys combining practical hands-on work with engineering activities

• likes helping colleagues solve technical challenges

• is curious and eager to develop new technical skills

• can communicate effectively with engineers and stakeholders across multiple disciplines

• takes ownership of tasks and follows them through to completion

• thrives in a collaborative team environment

**Why Join Us?

**At Demant, you will become part of a world-class technology organization developing products that improve the lives of millions of people with hearing loss.

We offer:

• a friendly and highly collaborative engineering environment

• access to advanced development laboratories and state-of-the-art technology

• opportunities to learn from experts across ASIC design, firmware, verification, and system development

• a thorough onboarding process and mentoring from experienced colleagues

• flexibility, professional development, and excellent employee benefits

Most importantly, you will play a central role in supporting the teams that create the technology behind some of the world's most advanced hearing solutions.

**Do You Want to Join the Team?

**Then please send your CV and application letter as soon as possible and no later than Sunday, October 25, 2026.

For any questions, please contact Peter Siegumfeldt, Senior Manager Chipset, at psie@demant.com.

_At Demant we value diversity, equity and inclusion (DE&I) and we are committed to creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of ethnic background, personality, age, gender, and education. Diversity is part of our cultural DNA. Women in STEM areas are particularly encouraged to apply, as Demant supports United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 5 on gender equality.

Your main responsibilities include:

jobs.description:
Lead the team. Grow the business. Shape what comes next.

Are you ready to lead commercial growth across a diverse and important healthcare customer segment? This is a visible leadership role where strategy, customer insight and an engaged sales team come together with real ownership of commercial performance and the future direction of the business.

At Mediq Denmark, you will lead a team of 8 sales professionals supporting GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals. You will work closely with the Sales Director to turn market insight into action, strengthen customer partnerships and identify the opportunities that can move the segment forward.

This is a role for a leader who enjoys being close to the market. One day you may be shaping the sales strategy or challenging a business case; the next, joining a strategic customer discussion, coaching a colleague or turning a new idea into a practical growth plan.

Your impact

You will set the direction for the segment and translate ambition into profitable, sustainable growth. With ownership of the sales budget, forecast and commercial performance, you will keep customer value, market opportunities and team development firmly in focus.

• Develop and execute the sales strategy for GP’s, specialist clinics and private hospitals, supported by clear segmentation, targeting and account plans.

• Strengthen relationships across the customer landscape, from individual practices to strategic private hospital accounts, and take an active role in key negotiations and customer meetings.

• Use customer, market and competitor insight to identify growth opportunities, shape go-to-market plans and guide pricing and commercial decisions.

• Lead, coach and develop eight sales professionals, creating clear priorities, accountability and the confidence to perform at their best.

• Connect Sales with Category, Product Management and Sourcing to align the assortment, supplier strategy and commercial priorities around a strong customer experience.

What you bring

We are looking for a commercially curious and customer-focused sales leader who sees the bigger picture, acts with pace and brings people with them. You are comfortable moving between strategic business development and hands-on sales leadership, and you know when to explore the detail and when to step back and set direction.

• At least five years of documented experience in a comparable commercial and leadership role, including leading, coaching and developing sales professionals.

• A strong track record in sales execution, performance management and working with sales processes at both operational and strategic level.

• Strong commercial and analytical judgement, including the ability to develop and assess business cases and make sound pricing and growth decisions.

• Confident negotiation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, supported by a structured and pragmatic approach to projects and processes.

• High energy, clear ownership and the ability to prioritise in a fast-paced and complex environment.

• Fluency in Danish and English. Experience from MedTech or the healthcare sector is an advantage.

Why join Mediq?

You will join a role where sales leadership is close to the action and your decisions will be visible. You will have the opportunity to influence commercial direction, build stronger customer partnerships and develop a team that can take this customer segment into its next chapter.

Our values - Customer Drive, Champion Spirit and Caring Heart - guide how we work, with a constant focus on creating value for patients.

Ready to lead the next stage of growth?

Bring your commercial leadership, customer focus and energy to Mediq. Help us strengthen the business, develop our people and build what comes next for customers across Denmark.

Location: Copenhagen Denmark.

Interested?

Submit your application through CareersatMediq.com or contact Artjoms.Bikovskis@Mediq.com, Talent Acquisition Partner Nordics and Baltics. We review every application with care and look forward to learning what you could bring to the future of Mediq Denmark.

We will be reviewing applications and interviewing candidates on a rolling basis as suitable candidates are identified. For this reason, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible.

About Mediq

Mediq is a leading European healthcare company with a 125-year legacy, operating in 14 countries with over 3,000 employees. Guided by our vision to enable sustainable healthcare, we focus on improving care outcomes and affordability through innovative products, services and solutions. Partnering with healthcare professionals across hospitals, clinics and home care, we help ensure patients receive the care they need to live independently, securely and feel more human.

_

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. • Complete assigned tasks thoroughly, accurately, and on time

You hold an M.D. degree and preferably also a Ph.D. degree. You have hands-on experience treating patients.

• Possess excellent communication skills (written and oral)

• Demonstrate sound judgement in terms of handling complex, confidential, and regulated information

You have a proven ability to learn quickly, even in fast‑paced environments.

You take ownership of your work, lead by example, and collaborate effectively with colleagues across the organization. You are trusted by others for your sound judgment and discretion, particularly when handling confidential, sensitive, or regulated information.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to be comfortable working with complex instructions, managing multiple priorities, and consistently maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Office: Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

jobs.occupation: Excellence & Engagement Manager - Health, Safety & Security
jobs.description:
Do you want to be a valued part of a global team that works passionately every day to ensure employees at DFDS go to work for DFDS and return safely and unharmed home to their loved ones? If this excites you then look no further and come join us.

About The Role  Be part of the movement - and play your part.   As Excellence & Engagement Manager in the Global Health, Safety & Security Team, you will be part of the continuous strengthening of DFDS’ health, safety and security culture. This is a new global role, and we expect you to participate in shaping and developing it. We anticipate that you will contribute by developing, implementing and continuously improving the frameworks, standards, tools, learning processes, communications and engagement activities that enable a strong Health, Safety & Security (HSS) performance across DFDS landside operations.

You will be responsible for ensuring consistent and effective deployment of group-wide HSS initiatives across DFDS operations area, supporting operational teams in anchoring safe and secure behaviors. The role works closely with the HSS Business Partners, other operational stakeholders and senior management to strengthen organizational learning, capability, culture and performance.

The role reports directly to the Global Director for HSS, and you will be based at our Global Headquarters in the port of Copenhagen. The role requires on-site presence.

What kind of exciting challenges can you expect to meet in this role?:  **Role

**As Excellence & Engagement Manager - HSS you will get the opportunity to influence and develop the role but the initial areas we expect you to cover are:

• Develop, coordinate and monitor global HSS initiatives.

• Develop, coordinate and maintain global HSS culture-building activities, campaigns and engagement programs aiming to strengthen safe and secure behaviors.

• Maintain and continuously improve our HSSEQ Management System.

• Develop, implement and continuously improve a Managers Toolkit on HSS.

• Manage Performance Monitoring and Improvement related to HSS in close collaboration with HSS Business Partners.

• Develop and coordinate DFDS’ organizational learning processes on HSS, ensuring learnings from incidents, audits etc. are translated into practical improvements and shared across the organization.

• Support leadership teams in understanding and applying HSS frameworks, standards and improvement methodologies.

• Build strong working relationships with operational leaders, local HSS teams, and functional stakeholders.

About You We think that the strongest teams are built on diversity and inclusivity. Contrasting opinions, varied skills and strong characters bring out the best in us all. With this in mind, we think that you are passionate about health, safety & security, have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, are a good listener and can digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

You Are Structured, Self-supporting And Capable Of Both Prioritizing And Multitasking In a Demanding Environment. Moreover, We Imagine That The Ideal Candidate Brings

• Ability to think strategically, translating HSS strategy into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes.

• A passion for building a strong HSS culture through engagement, communication and leadership influence.

• Experience in developing and implementing standards, frameworks and management systems within operational environments.

• Natural collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence without direct authority.

• Strong organizing skills, bringing structure, governance and consistency to complex initiatives.

• Capability to operate between strategy and execution, balancing long-term objectives with day-to-day deliveries, in a global corporate function.

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, good listening abilities, and the ability to digest large amounts of information and convert it into actions.

• A self-driven approach, with the ability to prioritize and multitask in a demanding environment.

**Furthermore, You Have

**

• A degree in business, organizational development, safety or security management, or related field.

• Proven experience (5+ years) within safety or security related functions in a global or matrixed organization.

• Experience in shipping, logistics, or industrial sectors is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of safety/security culture principles and organizational behavior is an advantage.

• Excellent presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

• Knowledge of or certification in change management methodologies is a plus.

• Project management certification (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) is an advantage.

• Proficiency in English (oral and written) as English is corporate language.

• Proficiency in Microsoft 365 suite.

• Experience in utilizing AI tools is an advantage.

Working at DFDS  Join the movement and grow with us.  While you’re with us, we want you to develop and move yourself on. We’ll encourage you to challenge yourself to acquire new skills and perspectives.

At DFDS, we promote a great workplace with a diverse and vibrant community. At our Copenhagen headquarters, we enjoy a modern workspace with award-winning facilities, different work zones, own game room, fitness facilities, canteen and a café with a rooftop terrace with a beautiful ocean view, all just 5 minutes from the nearest train & metro station.

Are we a match? Then what are you waiting for? Apply Now.   If you think your personality, skills, experience and aspirations match this role, we’d love to hear from you. Send us your resume as soon as possible as we’re keen to meet potential candidates on an ongoing basis.

Is there something you need to know, we haven’t covered here, please do not hesitate to reach out to Global Director HSS (Landside) Steffen Conradsen on sconr@dfds.com.

Please note that response times may be slightly longer than usual due to the autumn holiday period and business travel activities within the hiring team, however, rest assured that we will get back to you at earliest convenience.

We look forward to hearing from you.   This recruitment process is managed by the DFDS Talent Acquisition team. We kindly ask external recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting us regarding this opportunity.

Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Do you want to shape the engineering direction behind technology that drives the energy sector?

At Mind Energy, technology enables how we trade, optimise and evolve in a fast-moving energy market. As our Senior Software Engineer, you take a central role in building and evolving the digital backbone that supports critical business decisions every day.

You combine strong technical depth with architectural thinking and a hands-on engineering mindset. Working closely with experienced colleagues across development and business, you help shape scalable systems, influence technical direction and raise the engineering bar around you.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

In this role, you take an active par t in shaping the technical direction of our digital landscape. You modernise existing systems, build new solutions and turn complexity into reliable, scalable software that supports both trading and long-term growth.

Your mission is to:

• Design, develop, test and deploy stable, scalable and secure software solutions

• Take architectural responsibility and influence the long-term direction of our digital platform

• Build resilient services and systems designed for performance, scalability and maintainability

• Drive technical improvements and challenge existing solutions with a strong engineering mindset

• Collaborate closely across teams while supporting knowledge sharing, sparring and engineering quality

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

You’ll join an autonomous, cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of its domain, spanning design, architecture, implementation and operations.

Together, you work closely with business stakeholders to translate complex needs into robust, scalable and secure solutions that create real value for our customers.

At Mind Energy, we value both independence and collaboration.

Your work ranges from refining existing systems to shaping entirely new solutions, always with a clear sense of ownership and responsibility. You approach complexity with curiosity and turn challenges into solutions built to last.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are an experienced engineer who thrives with ownership, technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed and built. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural understanding and the confidence to challenge decisions when better

solutions exist.

We imagine that you bring:

• Extensive experience building scalable systems in C# and .NET, with a consistent approach to clean, maintainable code and modern design patterns

• Hands-on experience designing and building resilient, event-driven services in distributed and cloud-native environments

• Experience balancing scalability, reliability and maintainability when designing architectures for complex production systems

• Experience taking technical ownership and helping shape engineering direction through architectural decisions, sparring and pragmatic technical leadership

If you also have insight into the energy sector, it will be an advantage, but it is not required.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply, as we believe that a diverse team leads to innovation and success.

Please note that this role requires working from our office location Aarhus N.

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting and Christmas afternoons with your family and Santa. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognising that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If this sounds like the right fit for you - do not wait - send your resume as soon as you can, and no later than November 6, 2026.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Got questions or need more details? Reach out to Tony Frydensberg, Director, Head of IT Development at: tofr@mindenergy.com.

For general questions reach out to people@mindenergy.com

What if your code shaped the future of energy?

Energy is changing. Fast. And at Mind Energy, we’re right at the epicentre of it all.

For decades, we have led the way in European energy trading - impatiently pushing forward, turning our deep market knowledge into reliable solutions and trading strategies. Today, we trade across more than 40 markets. But it’s how we work that defines us: with curiosity, care and a mindset of “what if”. We listen, share, and push ideas forward - together.

Here, people matter, and we grow as specialists and as teammates. We bring many kinds of intelligence into play – from sharp thinking to smart models. That’s what makes us energy minds.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**Group IT keeps SimCorp running. The same discipline we bring to our clients' investment operations is applied to our own enterprise platforms. Workday and Salesforce are at the center of how we manage our people and client relationships.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. You will serve as the primary accountable leader for these platforms, partnering closely with business functions to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations through your leadership team and subject matter experts.

This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**The organization consists of:

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Define and own the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Workday and Salesforce, aligning platform capabilities and investments with business priorities and growth objectives

• Establish and chair platform governance forums with P&C, Sales, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, integrations, releases, and investment decisions

• Ensure the stability, performance, security, and availability of Workday and Salesforce through effective release management, testing, monitoring, and change control practices

• Oversee the end-to-end integration landscape across Workday, Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA

• Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including contracts, licensing, and commercial oversight in partnership with Software Asset Management

• Own platform security and access governance, including role design, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and compliance with internal control requirements

• Partner closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to ensure effective controls, timely remediation activities, and adherence to GDPR and other regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities to increase business value, operational efficiency, and user experience across the organization

**What We Value

**

• 10+ years of leadership experience in enterprise applications, with deep expertise in Workday and Salesforce, or solid hands-on experience in one platform combined with demonstrated leadership responsibility for the other

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

• A proven track record of establishing and operating governance models for enterprise platforms in a global, regulated, or financial services environment

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration architectures.

• Experience managing SaaS vendors, software licensing, commercial agreements, and strategic partner relationships

• Solid knowledge of data privacy, risk, and security frameworks, including GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both executive and technical levels

• Workday and/or Salesforce certifications are considered an advantage

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**For Poland Location

**Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Join IO Interactive’s Finance team at our Copenhagen Studio as Finance Director and play a key role in shaping the financial direction of a multi-studio, multi-entity games company. You will lead the Finance function, drive the automation of the finance processes, and act as the CFO's trusted partner and second-in-command. Responsible for the day-to-day leadership of Finance while providing strategic, financial, and commercial guidance that supports IO Interactive's continued growth across all studios.

If you are a strategic finance leader who combines commercial understanding with strong technical expertise, we would love to meet you.

**Please note that our finance team is primarily based in Copenhagen, and we would love local leadership; this position requires you to be on-site at our Copenhagen studio.

****What You Will Do

****Finance Leadership

**

• Lead the day-to-day Finance organisation across IO Interactive's global studios.

• Manage, drive, mentor, and develop Finance team members while building a high-performing and collaborative function.

• Drive the ongoing project of full automation of the finance process

• Act as the CFO's right-hand and trusted sparring partner on both operational and strategic matters.

• Ensure strong financial governance, controls, compliance, and scalable finance processes across the organisation.

**Financial & Business Leadership

**

• Own budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning across all studios and entities.

• Provide strategic financial insight and recommendations to the CFO and senior leadership team.

• Translate financial and operational performance into clear actions and business recommendations.

• Support decision-making related to investments, headcount planning, studio growth and organisational development.

• Partner with Production, Commercial, Technology and Corporate leadership on financial performance and business priorities.

• Drive performance management through meaningful reporting, KPIs and financial analysis.

**Controlling & Governance

**

• Upscale and improve Financial and Business controlling.

• Oversee Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling activities across the organisation.

• Ensure accurate management reporting and financial visibility across studios, projects and functions.

• Oversee external audits, statutory compliance, and financial risk management.

• Support finance transformation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Who You Are

**

• Significant experience in a senior Finance leadership role.

• Strong background across Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling.

• Experience leading and driving Finance teams in a complex international organisation.

• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to influence strategic business decisions.

• Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and senior leadership teams.

• Excellent understanding of financial reporting, governance, planning, and performance management.

• Strong leadership skills and ability to operate as a trusted advisor.

**We would love it if you had

**

• Experience working in the gaming industry.

• Previous experience in an audit firm earlier in your career.

• Experience supporting multi-studio, multi-entity, or international organisations.

• Experience with ERP transformations

• Experience with Unit4 or similar ERP systems.

• Experience with Prophix or similar systems.

• Accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or equivalent.

**Who We Are

**IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are committed to creating unforgettable characters and experiences—powered by our award-winning, proprietary Glacier technology.

IOI is a studio that values in-person collaboration. Being together helps us focus our collective energy on our immediate goals. For us, being both in-office as well as connected across our studios helps us integrate our teams faster, strengthen relationships, and improve knowledge-sharing. We believe that the more time we spend together, the more quality and progress we achieve for our games and players.

We know that to achieve those goals, we need courage, talented people, and a great working environment—and we do our utmost to have all of that. Across our multiple studios, we’re working on several projects. Crucially, though, we’re all one team. We value the work and impact that each person brings to the table, and we actively encourage new ideas whilst listening to your insights along the way.

With more than 50 nationalities, we know that everyone is different, and we are proud to have a reputation for being a friendly workplace with highly talented people.

IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Brighton and Istanbul. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences – all powered by our award-winning proprietary Glacier technology.
